Fixed. Two changes, no commit made.

**`lib/hooks.js:308`** — `onSendHookRunner` (also used as `preSerializationHookRunner`) called `next(null, newPayload)` directly from the promise continuation. When the terminal callback threw — e.g. `onSendEnd` → `safeWriteHead` raising `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` — the throw escaped as an unhandled rejection, uncatchable by the user. It is now caught and routed to `cb(error, request, reply, payload)`, the same error path the callback-style hooks take when `next(err)` is used.

**`lib/error-handler.js:38`** — the tail of that error path also threw uncatchably: after the first `reply.raw.writeHead(statusCode, headers)` failed and was logged via `writeHeadError`, the retry `writeHead(statusCode)` threw again and escaped the promise continuation. The retry is now guarded; the error was already logged and the headers are gone, so there is nothing left to do but finish the response.

Verified with a throwaway repro (async `onSend`, async `preSerialization`, sync `onSend`, and no hook): before, all three hook variants ended in `UNHANDLED REJECTION: ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT`; after, every variant settles with a logged 500 carrying `code: ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` and the no-hook case still returns 200.

Test: added a regression test for both async hook paths in `test/hooks-async.test.js` (it fails an assertion on any `unhandledRejection`). `node --test test/hooks-async.test.js` — 36/36 pass. The existing sync contract is preserved: `test/internals/reply.test.js:1894` asserts `reply.send()` still rethrows `ERR_HTTP_HEADERS_SENT` synchronously, and the fix only touches the promise continuation.

COMPLEX.md notes: `lib/hooks.js` is a listed hotspot (I read its paragraph — "the tests are the specification", hence running the hook suite and adding the test). It has no `co_change` partner; `lib/reply.js`/`lib/request.js` — the pair coupled to this lifecycle — needed no change, since `safeWriteHead`'s throw is the correct signal and only its propagation was broken. No hook was added, so `types/hooks.d.ts`/`types/instance.d.ts` are untouched.
